description: This is a modern, compact two-seater sofa, featuring a minimalist design with clean lines. It is upholstered in a light beige or off-white textured fabric. The sofa has slim, integrated armrests and rests on sleek, dark-colored metal legs, giving it a contemporary, floating appearance. It is adorned with three throw pillows: a prominent central pillow with a bold, colorful geometric pattern in shades of orange, teal, brown, and red, flanked by two smaller pillows with a subtle light gray and white checkered pattern.
